newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Petron tenders to buy May Qatar Marine or U.Zakum.
newsitem.headline: Petron tenders to buy May Qatar Marine or U.Zakum.

text.p: Philippines oil refinery Petron Corp has issued a tender to buy 500,000 barrels of May loading Qatar Marine or Upper Zakum crude, traders said on Monday.
The tender closes at 1500 hours Manila time (0700 GMT) later on Monday and offers should be valid until 0800 hours (0000 GMT) on Tuesday.
Petron rarely issued a tender to buy spot crude oil. The company is 40-percent owned by Saudi Aramco, which also provides a steady flow of Arabian crude oil for the Philippines refiner.
Traders said the tender was issued to exploit the current weak price for Qatar Marine. The crude traded at ADNOC less 45 to 50 cents last week.
Upper Zakum is not often seen on the spot market.
